# AgentRoom iOS - Full Docs

> AgentRoom iOS is the native SwiftUI client for pairing with an AgentRoom daemon, inspecting room state, and steering work from a phone without inventing a second room API.

Generated from the live docs site. Each section below is one page; see the heading and source path for context.

---

# Overview

Source: `README.md` - https://volpestyle.github.io/docs/agent-room-ios/?doc=overview

# AgentRoom iOS

Native iOS prototype for checking and steering an AgentRoom from the phone. The
visual direction is stripped, dark, and operational, matching the
[v4 Figma mockups](https://www.figma.com/design/T6jICC07t8CpNZYm9PRQie/swarm-ios-%E2%80%94-mockups).

## 1. What You Can Do

- pair with a local AgentRoom daemon over a private tailnet
- store the daemon URL in app preferences and the token in Keychain
- inspect workspace, tab, pane, and connection state away from the desk
- move through the same room hierarchy the TUI exposes locally
- prototype the mobile operator surface without inventing a second room API

<!-- Capture backlog:
- docs/assets/gifs/mobile-room-check.gif: run agent-room mobile-connect --copy, open the link on iPhone, and inspect a room over tailnet.
-->

## 2. What The App Lets AgentRoom Handle

The iOS app is only the client. AgentRoom owns the daemon API, auth semantics,
room state, runtime bindings, and pairing payload. When the app needs new
behavior, update or document the AgentRoom daemon contract first, then wire the
SwiftUI client to that contract.

## 3. Mental Model

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  phone["iPhone app"]
  tailnet["Private LAN / Tailscale"]
  daemon["agentroomd"]
  room["AgentRoom room<br/>events, agents, tasks, runtime state"]

  phone --> tailnet
  tailnet --> daemon
  daemon --> room
```

HTTP URLs are accepted only for local/private LAN and Tailscale modes. Custom
endpoints must use HTTPS.

## Connect

Start the AgentRoom daemon locally:

```bash
agent-room daemon start
```

For a phone on your private network, start the daemon on the tailnet and print
the mobile payload:

```bash
AGENTROOM_API_TOKEN="$(openssl rand -hex 24)" agent-room daemon start --tailnet
agent-room mobile-connect --copy
```

Open the copied `agentroom://connect?...` link on the iPhone with Universal
Clipboard, Messages, AirDrop, or Notes. Manual URL/token entry is still
supported from the connection screen.

## Run

```bash
brew install xcodegen      # if not already installed
xcodegen generate          # regenerate SwarmiOS.xcodeproj from project.yml
open SwarmiOS.xcodeproj    # pick iPhone 17 Pro, Cmd+R
```

Command line:

```bash
xcodebuild -project SwarmiOS.xcodeproj \
  -scheme SwarmiOS \
  -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' \
  build
```

## Documentation

The hosted docs UI renders this README as the source of truth.

```bash
pnpm docs:dev
pnpm docs:build
```

## Structure

```text
SwarmiOS/
  SwarmiOSApp.swift
  RootView.swift
  Tokens/
  Models/
  Components/
  Screens/
```

The seeded `AppStore.demo()` workspace `swarm-mcp` has 2 tabs and 5 panes. Open
it from the list view to see the workspace, tab, and pane hierarchy before
connecting to a live daemon.
